items.title: AI image models hallucinate history, we built a method to fix it it
items.raw_excerpt:
We created 24 image prompts across 3 characters living in Rome, 110 CE. Each prompt has a naive version and a culturally-grounded version enhanced by the Triad Engine (structured domain knowledge injection). Same model, same pipeline, only the prompt changes. A blinded Gemini Vision judge scores each pair without knowing which is which. Results: RAW (naive prompt): 12.5% historically accurate
TRIAD (grounded prompt): 83.3% historically accurate
In 23 of 24 pairs, the grounded image was judged more accurate
In 0 of 24 pairs was the naive image judged better

items.title: Mcp2cli – One CLI for every API, 96-99% fewer tokens than native MCP
items.raw_excerpt: Every MCP server injects its full tool schemas into context on every turn — 30 tools costs ~3,600 tokens/turn whether the model uses them or not. Over 25 turns with 120 tools, that's 362,000 tokens just for schemas. mcp2cli turns any MCP server or OpenAPI spec into a CLI at runtime. The LLM discovers tools on demand: mcp2cli --mcp https://mcp.example.com/sse --list # ~16 tokens/tool mcp2cli --mcp https://mcp.example.com/sse create-task --help # ~120 tokens, once mcp2cli --mcp https://mcp.example.com/sse create-task --title "Fix bug" No codegen, no rebuild when the server changes. Works with any LLM — it's just a CLI the model shells out to. Also handles OpenAPI specs (JSON/YAML, local or remote) with the same interface. Token savings are real, measured with cl100k_base: 96% for 30 tools ov

items.title: Salvobase – MongoDB-compatible DB in Go maintained by AI agents
items.raw_excerpt: MongoDB is great until you read the SSPL. Then you're either paying Atlas prices, running an old 4.x build, or pretending FerretDB is production-ready. We built a third option. Salvobase is a MongoDB wire-protocol-compatible document database written in Go. Point any Mongo driver and it works. No driver changes, no config changes. It's Apache 2.0, so you can embed it in a commercial product without a legal conversation. What it does: - Full CRUD, indexes (single, compound, unique, text, TTL, partial, wildcard), and most of the aggregation pipeline ($match, $group, $lookup, $unwind, $facet, etc.) - SCRAM-SHA-256 auth - bbolt storage engine: one .db file per database, Snappy-compressed BSON - Built-in Prometheus metrics at :27080/metrics (no exporter needed) - Built-in REST/JSON API at :2708

items.title: OpenVerb – A deterministic action layer for AI agents
items.raw_excerpt: Hi HN, I’ve been working on a project called OpenVerb, which explores an architectural idea for AI systems: separating reasoning from execution. Most AI agent frameworks today focus on improving reasoning loops, planning, and orchestration (LangChain, LangGraph, etc.). That approach works, but it also creates some issues: • custom glue code for every integration • inconsistent action schemas • limited determinism in execution • difficult auditing and policy enforcement OpenVerb experiments with treating actions as a protocol layer, not just function calls. items.title: Chat AI Agent inside mobile device testing sessions
items.raw_excerpt:

excerpt_i18n.es: Del 16 al 18 de abril, la conferencia global de desarrollo de software QCon se celebrará en Pekín. Esta edición se centra en la reconfiguración de la ingeniería de software en la era de la IA agéntica, abordando temas de vanguardia como la IA agéntica, la colaboración multiagente, la optimización de la potencia computacional, la gestión de la deuda técnica, la multimodalidad y la infraestructura nativa de IA. Se invitará a expertos técnicos de empresas como Tencent, Alibaba, Baidu, Huawei, Ant Group, Xiaomi y NetEase, quienes presentarán más de cien casos prácticos reales, compartiendo sistemáticamente perspectivas avanzadas y conocimientos aplicados, explorando nuevas vías para la implementación de la IA mediante la colaboración tecnológica.

excerpt_i18n.en:
On March 7, the "Visibility Growth Summit," jointly organized by Yeahmobi, Feifan Industrial Research, Similarweb, and Tencent Cloud, successfully concluded in Nanshan, Shenzhen. Focusing on the core of brand growth in the AI era, the summit brought together leading forces in global digital marketing, including AppLovin, Shopify, Moloco, impact.com, and Zhipu AI. It systematically shared actionable AI growth methodologies for practitioners such as brand founders, overseas expansion strategists, and growth leaders, exploring how brands can build core "visibility capabilities" in the intelligent age.  

Guided by practical application, the summit featured three specialized sessions: "Visibility × Search," "Visibility × Advertising," and "Visibility × Agent." Through keynote speeches and in-depth roundtable discussions, it systematically presented practical pathways for brands to build visibility capabilities in the AI era, covering dimensions such as generative search optimization, AI advertising automation, and intelligent agent commercial deployment. The summit also provided actionable guidance for enterprises to break through growth bottlenecks and seize algorithmic dividends.  

Additionally, the summit released the "2026 Global AI Marketing Trends and Value White Paper," jointly initiated by Yeahmobi and Alibaba Cloud, with participation from industry pioneers such as Google, PubMatic, BIGO Ads, Smadex, Adjust, Salesforce, Crazy Maple Studio, Jetour Automobile, realme, Pixel Bloom, Huxiu Think Tank, and Yangfan Chuhai.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 7 de marzo, la "Cumbre de Crecimiento de Visibilidad", organizada conjuntamente por Yeahmobi, Feifan Industrial Research, Similarweb y Tencent Cloud, concluyó con éxito en Nanshan, Shenzhen. Centrándose en el núcleo del crecimiento de marca en la era de la IA, esta cumbre reunió a líderes globales en marketing digital como AppLovin, Shopify, Moloco, impact.com y Zhipu AI, compartiendo sistemáticamente metodologías prácticas de crecimiento con IA para fundadores de marcas, responsables de expansión internacional y líderes de crecimiento, y explorando cómo las marcas pueden construir capacidades centrales de "visibilidad" en la era inteligente. Orientada a la práctica, la cumbre incluyó la sesión "Visibilidad × Búsqueda".
